name: Re:cord NOAH Boukyaku no Fractal
original_name: Re:cord NOAH 忘却のフラクタル
source:
Noah, a city on the sea.
Here, in this place of peace and order, beings called Sylphids use emotions as energy.

Only slightly more attuned to emotions than most, protagonist Lila crosses paths with the android 50Y-O-61 one day in a meeting ordained by fate.

Unbeknownst to her, that encounter will come to unseal a legacy.
